title: The Bundle of Blues short
summary: Willard reads the personnel of the 1938 Paramount short with Florence Mills and Bessie Dudley; Tizol doesn't recall it.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: There is also a listing here for "Bundle of Blues," 1938. It was "an eight minute short; a Paramount musical short featuring Duke Ellington and his orchestra with 'Rocking and Rhythm,' a vocal rendering of 'Stormy Weather' by Ivy Anderson and a tap dance routine from Florence Mills and Bessie Dudley to 'Bugle Call Rag.'" "Personnel -- Marshall Royal, Harry Carney, Barney Bigard, Johnny Hodges, Tricky Sam Nanton, Juan Tizol, Lawrence Brown, trombones; Cootie Williams, Arthur Whetsol, Freddie Jenkins, trumpets; Fred Guy, guitar, Wellman Braud, bass; Sonny Greer, percussion; and Ellington -- piano.
Do you remember making a short subject with Florence Mills and Bessie Dudley? For Paramount?
Oh, that's a little too far for me.
Do you remember Florence Mills or and Bessie Dudley? Bessie Dudley, I think, was a dancer, right?
You never worked with Florence Mills, didn't you, Juan?
No, I don't believe I ever worked with Florence Mills.
Not even in a short film?
Maybe that was done separately and put together.
